Bounded state-retry exhaustion, and purge --all during a Signal-origin provider run before any checkpoint (DeliveryCancelled skips status write), can leave a run row in running.
Broadcast stops whole account on UNKNOWN/NETWORK_FAILURE; consistent with design recovery fence.
Background agents cannot send to Signal (EXECUTION_UNAVAILABLE); fail-closed and documented.
Bridge gate reset on new secret can drop a still-pending predecessor admission (no-events fresh-session path only).
performReload has no try/finally after quiesceClaims.

No status indicator for a pending reload while all channels' claims are quiesced (log-only, documented).
queue-purge reports only deleted count, not cancellation counts; documented.
triggerPrefix with leading/trailing whitespace validates but cannot match as intended; documented warning only.

Registry only resolves runner-registered runIds, so background-agent Signal channel_send/broadcast always get EXECUTION_UNAVAILABLE (fail-closed); limitation not recorded against AC-12.
